name: @millstone/synapse-site
description: Quartz 4 configuration for Synapse documentation site

scripts.build:decap: npm run build:decap-config && tsx decap/generate-doc-types.ts && tsx decap/build-vault-index.ts && npm run build:validate-bundle
scripts.build: npm run sync-plugins && npm run build:decap && (cd quartz && npx quartz build) && npm run copy:decap
scripts.serve: npm run sync-plugins && npm run build:decap && cd quartz && npx quartz build --serve
scripts.dev: npm run sync-plugins && npm run build:decap && npm run copy:decap && cd quartz && npx quartz build --serve --port 8080
scripts.clean: rm -rf quartz/public quartz/.quartz-cache static/edit/*.json static/edit/schemas static/edit/body-grammars static/edit/validate.bundle.js decap/doc-types.generated.ts
